title: Venezuelan-Style Grilled Shrimp Pilaf
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make pilaf dish with a twist of Venezuelan spices, served with charred shrimp.

ingredients.name: Quick-cooking shrimp
ingredients.notes: Fresh or frozen, peeled and deveined

ingredients.name: Venezuelan spices
ingredients.notes: A mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

ingredients.name: Charred bell peppers
ingredients.notes: Roasted bell peppers for added flavor

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the charred onions and bell peppers, and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the Venezuelan spices and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the quick-cooking shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Add the pre-cooked pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with the shrimp and vegetables.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
